view_definitions.absolute_symplectic_features: direct difference after taking absolute values of omega-based features
view_definitions.combinatorics: direct unlabelled combinatorial difference; all named invertible transformations preserve it
view_definitions.euclidean_features: direct difference of Euclidean metric features of the two nominal arms, without quotient alignment
view_definitions.law_parameters: direct difference of probability laws/marks after the stated law-level coupling or pushforward
view_definitions.matrix_identity: residual of the row's declared matrix/form identity, not distance of the transform from identity
view_definitions.normalized_product_features: direct difference of the declared scale/area/volume-normalized product features
view_definitions.raw_geometry_after_transform: residual after explicitly applying the row's named geometric transformation
view_definitions.signed_symplectic_features: direct difference of signed omega-based features of the two nominal arms
